text: naming-convention §2 names the returned proof sheet '<Client> - Client Proof Sheet - RETURNED.md', but returns can arrive as a form JSON export; no rule for a non-Markdown return.

text: evidence_pack.py review_topics gives 'service: <name>' topics no facts.json R key, so a service review topic can never be checked by meaning and stays 'unchecked'; for svc-gutter-cleaning most of its 9 matches are installation clean-up, not the gutter-cleaning service. Also staff_names() took 'Inc' (from 'Inc.' in company names) as a staff member.
workaround: Researcher recorded staff:Inc count 0; the service topic stays at the keyword-match tier (attributed example only) and the writer is told not to treat it as reviewers praising gutter cleaning.

text: Spec LOC-02 (location SEO title 'Brand - GB Category - City, Full State Name') conflicts with Paul's settled title_format.location ('Category Variant in City, ST - Brand'); also the GB category is the homepage's reserved variant (CM-024). text: evidence.py questions (facts pack, batch services) repeats the same wording for every page: 'Typical job duration' and 'Price range' each appear 6 times quoting the same site text, and the first one quotes the phone number and nav text. Duplicate-by-wording should be collapsed in the pack, keeping one settle key per fact.

text: evidence_pack.review_topics gives 'service: <name>' topics an empty key list, so a researcher's reviews.py checked can never move them from 'keyword match only' to known (4 service topics with 3+ reviewers in the services packs: Gutter Installation 32, Gutter Downspouts 4, Gutter Guards 4, Seamless Gutter Installation 3). reviews.py meaning has no API key and falls back to the researcher.
